# Product UI · 产品界面

What actually ships: screens and flows from real products, component references, official platform guidelines and published design systems. Prefer these over concept shots for anything users will operate daily.

61 resources, plus 12 cross-listed from other domains. Columns are explained in README.md; `python3 "$S/catalog.py" find` (`S` = `skills/design-studio/scripts`) searches every domain at once. Rows are sorted by tier, then by reach, so what an agent can fetch comes first.

## Real-product screens and flows · 真实产品界面与流程

Look up the screen type or flow in several shipped products before designing it. Convention is a feature.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |

## Component references · 组件参考

Anatomy, naming, states and keyboard behaviour of a component across systems.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [The Component Gallery](https://component.gallery) | Every common UI component with its names and implementations across dozens of design systems, linked to their docs and code | Open /components/<name> (for example /components/accordion) to compare names, anatomy and behaviour across systems, each linked to its docs and code; /design-systems lists the sources. | S | pattern-library | static | free | [Accordion across systems (example)](https://component.gallery/components/accordion/); [Source data (GitHub)](https://github.com/inbn/component-gallery) |
| [ARIA Authoring Practices Guide (home: a11y)](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/) | Canonical keyboard interaction and ARIA roles for each widget pattern (combobox, menu, tabs, dialog) | Read the pattern page (combobox, menu button, tabs, dialog, grid) for keyboard interaction and ARIA roles before specifying any custom interactive component, and prefer the native element when one exists. Agents: the pattern sources are on GitHub. | S | guideline | static | free | [APG pattern sources (GitHub)](https://github.com/w3c/aria-practices/tree/main/content/patterns) |
| [UI Guideline](https://www.uiguideline.com) | Component standards synthesised from many design systems: anatomy, properties, states | Open a component to see its anatomy, properties and states synthesised from several systems; copy the state list into the spec so none is forgotten. | A | pattern-library | static | free |  |
| [Open UI](https://open-ui.org) | W3C community research on component anatomy, naming and behaviour across systems | Use the research pages per component (select, popover, tabs) for anatomy names and the cross-system comparison before naming parts or states in a spec; proposals here often become HTML features (popover, customizable select). | A | guideline | static | free |  |
| [Inclusive Components (home: a11y)](https://inclusive-components.design) | Accessible component patterns explained in depth (toggles, menus, tabs, cards, notifications) | Read the matching article before building the component | A | article | static | free · archived |  |
| [Checklist Design](https://www.checklist.design) | Checklists of what a component, page or flow must include | Open the checklist for the component, page or flow you are about to hand off (for example login, pricing page, table) and tick each item against the design; missing states are the usual gap. | A | pattern-library | js | free |  |
| [UX Patterns for Developers](https://uxpatterns.dev) | 90+ UI patterns, each documented with anatomy, best practices, accessibility and testing, framework-agnostic, with an MCP server and llms.txt for agents | Before building a pattern you have not specified (combobox, infinite scroll, date input), read its page or point the agent at /llms.txt or the MCP server. | A | pattern-library | blocked | free · MIT | [llms.txt](https://uxpatterns.dev/llms.txt) |
| [UI Playbook](https://uiplaybook.dev) | Documented collection of component best practices | Quick reminder of do and don't per component | B | pattern-library | static | free · slow |  |

## Published design systems · 公开的设计系统

Read the pattern and content guidance, not just the components. Pick a system from a comparable domain.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Carbon Design System](https://carbondesignsystem.com) | IBM's system: the best public reference for dense enterprise UI, data tables, data visualisation and AI labelling | Read Patterns (data tables, forms, empty states), Data visualization and Carbon for AI; agents should start from /llms.txt, which indexes every section. | S | system | static | free · Apache-2.0 | [llms.txt (agent index)](https://carbondesignsystem.com/llms.txt) |
| [GOV.UK Design System](https://design-system.service.gov.uk) | Research-backed patterns for forms, errors and step-by-step services; the gold standard for clarity and accessibility | Read Patterns (ask users for dates, addresses, names; check answers; question pages) and the error-message guidance; every pattern cites its research. | S | system | static | free · MIT | [Patterns](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/); [Source (GitHub)](https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-design-system) |

Ant Design Pro and ProComponents are the usual admin layout layer. | S | system | static | free · MIT | [llms.txt (agent index)](https://ant.design/llms.txt); [DESIGN.md of the design language](https://ant.design/design.md); [设计规范](https://ant.design/docs/spec/introduce-cn); [ProComponents](https://procomponents.ant.design) |

## Details and out-of-category sources · 细节与跨界来源

Game HUDs, fictional interfaces and small delights - for immersive, full-screen and one-memorable-moment problems.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Apple Design Awards (home: motion)](https://developer.apple.com/design/awards/) | Winners and finalists each year with video of the shipped app; the Interaction and Delight and Fun categories are a curated reel of platform-native motion | Watch the Interaction category videos frame by frame for gesture-driven, interruptible transitions; compare with Apple's HIG before copying an idiom | A | gallery | static | free |  |
| [Detail (multi) (home: motion)](https://detail.design) | Curated short recordings of the small decisions that make shipped software feel considered, tagged Design, Interactivity, Motion, Copywriting, Accessibility and Easter Egg | Filter to Motion or Interactivity and study one detail at a time: what triggers it, how long it runs and why it earns its place; a Chinese edition lives at /zh | A | gallery | static | freemium | [中文版 (Chinese edition)](https://detail.design/zh) |
| [ProtoPie (multi) (home: motion)](https://www.protopie.io) | High-fidelity interaction prototyping without code: variables, conditions, device sensors and multi-screen links, playable on real devices | Prototype the one interaction whose feel is contested (a gesture, a sheet, a car HMI screen), test it on the device, then hand the timings to engineering | A | tool | static | freemium · login |  |
